name: agentic-media-stack
description: Router and installer for the open-source agentic media stack: HyperFrames (HTML to MP4), video-use (agent video editing), and the ai-agents-skills creative suite. Bundles the MCP servers these workflows need. Includes Hebrew/RTL production rules, transcription-based QA for AI-generated speech video, reference-photo rules for putting real people into generated images, and a guided beginner mode that is safe for kids.
